_doc: SHA-256 provenance guard for the ASHRAE 140-2023 canonical weather binding (loop round 41). These checksums pin the two files extracted from ASHRAE's free supplemental-files package (see scripts/fetch_ashrae140_weather.py for the URL and member paths). The files themselves are fetched at build/test time and never committed (assets/weather/ashrae140/ is git-ignored). Verified 2026-10-15 on the direct download from https://xp20.ashrae.org/supplementalfiles/140-2023-AccompanyingFiles.zip.
provenance: ASHRAE Standard 140-2023 Accompanying Files; DRYCOLD.TMY725650TY.CSV is the normative weather (Std140 section 5.2.1.1.1.1 / Annex A1.1.1.1, TMY3 station 725650 Denver Intl AP); Tsky-Informative.xlsx is the informative modified Martin-Berdahl (1984) sky-temperature series with Clark-Allen cloud correction (Annex A1.1.1.2). Underlying TMY3 data are NREL public domain.
